propositions: Jira Data Center rate-limiting (HTTP 429) responses propagate as hard failures because the transport does not honour Retry-After headers or retry on 429 status codes

The transport's single retry choke point _with_connection_retry fronts all 15 call sites including mutations (create_issue, add_comment), so 429 retry must be scoped to idempotent reads only to avoid reintroducing duplicate-issue bugs

Retry-After delay must be parsed from exc.response.headers, apply jitter (0–20% random per Atlassian guidance), then clamp to MAX_BACKOFF_S, with missing headers treated as absent rate limiting (admin off, pre-8.6, or Server edition)
transport.py is at a locked 800-line capacity with only 11 lines of headroom, forcing extraction of the retry/error cluster to a separate module before 429 policy can be added in place
